name: translate-fr
summary: Translate an English operational summary and structured facts into French via templates and glossary substitution.
description: Fourth node of the report.* chain. Model-free EN→FR translation: PROJECT phrase templates (combines distributed browser / shows how adaptive summarization) fill PROJECT and N placeholders; Fact lines use case-sensitive exact template match; otherwise ordered glossary substitution. Empty input yields empty output. Pure, deterministic, memory-only — no embeddings, model, network, or host state.

use_cases.scenario: As a rollout coordinator, I want a named project summary translated with filled placeholders, so that French stakeholders see the same deterministic operational narrative.

input_example.summary: Acme Rollout combines distributed browser, edge, and cloud evidence into a deterministic operational summary with 2 validated insights.

output_example.translated_summary: Acme Rollout combine des preuves distribuees du navigateur, de l'edge et du cloud dans un resume operationnel deterministe avec 2 observation(s) validee(s).

use_cases.scenario: As a rollout coordinator, I want an exact Fact template translated verbatim, so that known enrichment lines stay consistent across locales.

structured_facts: Fact: An edge cache exposes regional rollout data with low latency.

translated_facts: Fait : un cache edge expose les donnees de deploiement regional avec une faible latence.

use_cases.scenario: As a rollout coordinator, I want unknown phrasing to fall back to glossary substitution rather than inventing text, so that partial translations remain deterministic and honest.

input_example.summary: Fact: browser telemetry and low latency matter.

output_example.translated_summary: Fait : telemetrie du navigateur and faible latence matter.

preconditions.description: Caller supplies summary string and structured_facts array (either may be empty).

postconditions.description: Identical input always yields identical translated_summary and translated_facts. Template matching and glossary substitution use no randomness, clocks, embeddings, or host state.

side_effects.description: Produces translated strings in memory; does not log, persist, or transmit inputs.

provenance.author: enricopiovesan
provenance.spec_ref: registry#426 / UMA chapter-13 report chain port
